subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the reported generated-doc gap, and two open conflicting PRs attempt overlapping fixes with different proof and implementation quality signals.

options.title: Refresh the stronger proven PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable adopting the contributor branch after conflict resolution and fresh proof.

options.title: Repair the same-author PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 if maintainers prefer the issue author's smaller branch after it adds sufficient real behavior proof and resolves conflicts.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Close or pause both overlapping branches and ask for one narrow generator/check PR if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh the stronger proven PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable adopting the contributor branch after conflict resolution and fresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent adjacent SecretRef docs stabilization history and is the best available routing owner for choosing the implementation path.
